rigorous_structural_case.reproductive_condition: no functional visitor types; prior selfing; founder allele frequencies held equal by exact cloning
rigorous_structural_case.reason: No outcrossing; normalized reproduction weights over genotype copies invariant to cloning K/8, so offspring phenotype expectation and nonzero mean shift are constant for every such K.
rigorous_structural_case.conclusion: A finite-drift Ito SDE limit on accelerated dt=1/K using unscaled frozen source reproduction cannot cover this family of states.
rigorous_structural_case.scope: Not a proof that other weak-selection or stochastic genotype measure/SPDE models are impossible.

research_boundary.reason: At zero mutation source founders have both assurance alleles fixed at 0.5; no initial assurance variation.
